register_converter_decorator: register a converter function for a source type using the BaseConverter register decorator
register_converter_direct: register a converter directly by calling BaseConverter register with a type and callable
convert_instance: convert an instance to the destination type using a registered converter via BaseConverter convert
lookup_converter: look up a registered converter for a given type using BaseConverter _lookup_converter with recursive base class search
make_int_box: create a 4-tuple of integers from a PyTorch tensor bounding box using make_int_box
